To answer, Mysone sends an excerpt of your transcripts to an AI provider. It stays off until you choose a provider, enter your API key and accept the notice. Meanwhile, you can search what you\'ve heard: it works offline.
You already have a provider (%1$s), an API key and the notice accepted: turn AI on to ask. Meanwhile, you can search what you\'ve heard: it works offline.

Mysone can run in the background without battery restrictions.
Android may throttle listening to save battery. Allow Mysone to run without restrictions.
You\'ve restricted Mysone\'s battery use, so it can\'t listen in the background. Change it to “Unrestricted” in the app settings.
On Samsung, go to Battery › Background usage limits, take Mysone out of “Sleeping apps” and add it to “Never sleeping apps”. Also turn off “Put unused apps to sleep”.
On Xiaomi, turn on Autostart for Mysone, set its Battery saver to “No restrictions” and lock it with the padlock in Recents.
On Pixel phones, removing the battery restrictions is usually enough.
Some manufacturers close background apps even when they have permission. Look up what you need to change on your %1$s.
Transcription is always done on your phone. AI is optional: it generates titles, summaries, tasks and answers, and to do that it sends text to a provider using your own API key.
First save the provider\'s API key.

Switching provider deletes the saved API key and you\'ll have to accept the notice again.
The saved API key will be deleted and AI will stay off until you enter the new provider\'s key and accept the notice.
It\'s stored encrypted on your phone and never shown again.
An encrypted API key is saved. Type another only if you want to change it.
Titles, summaries and tasks in the background. A small, cheap one is best.
Newest first. Only those that can return the JSON Mysone asks for.

With 3 h of speech a day, processing with Haiku 5.5 costs about $1 a month, and each question answered with Opus 5.5 costs between 0.5 and 1.5 cents.
With 3 h of speech a day, between $1.5 a month (everything on Small) and $7.5 (with Medium for answers).
It depends on the model: in “Choose from the list” you\'ll see what each one costs per million input and output tokens.
With 3 h of speech a day, about $1.5–2 a month.
It depends on the provider and the models. For reference, a small model comes to $1–2 a month with 3 h of speech a day.
With Opus in the background too, the cost rises to about $35–45 a month.
You pay the provider directly with your API key. Approximate figures from October 2026: check their prices.
Mysone will send the text of your transcripts to %1$s (%2$s) to summarize them, extract tasks and answer your questions. It may include what other people said. The audio never leaves your phone.

What happens to your data depends on whoever runs that server.
DeepSeek stores data in China and may use it to train its models. If you record other people\'s conversations, sending them to DeepSeek may breach the GDPR. We don\'t recommend it.

resources.string: In the audio files and calls you import, Mysone marks who says each sentence: “Speaker 1”, “Speaker 2”… It\'s calculated on your phone and only for what you import from now on. Live listening doesn\'t do it.
What you import will stop marking who\'s speaking until you download it again (%1$s). What\'s already marked stays. If you enrolled your voice, it\'s deleted too.
If you enroll your voice, your sentences will show up as “You”. It\'s stored only on your phone.
Your voice is enrolled: in what you import, your sentences show up as “You”.
Tap “Start” and read aloud in your normal tone. If you finish before the bar fills up, read it again.

Saves your conversations, transcripts, tasks, memories, chat and settings to a JSON file. It doesn\'t include the AI API key or your enrolled voice.
The file contains other people\'s words. Sharing it beyond your personal use may violate their privacy or data protection rights. Keep it somewhere safe and don\'t circulate it.
Deletes everything stored on your phone. The transcription and voice models are kept.
Conversations, transcripts, tasks, reminders, memories, the chat and your enrolled voice are deleted, along with the settings and the AI API key. Listening will stop.
If you want to keep something, cancel and export your data first.
Listens in the background, transcribes on your phone and helps you remember what you\'ve talked about. The audio is never stored.
